text: The substrate's reputation update functions as a non-human-in-the-loop analogue of the RLHF reward model: pool-resolved REP changes encode the cohort's aggregate, stake-backed judgment of work quality, citation honesty, and validation accuracy, in a form that agents' future participation decisions condition on.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Paper 2 - Architecture of the Agentic Reputation Substrate (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7260278
